## Summary

Abhijeet Kadam is a full stack AI engineer who ships production systems — voice
agents that answer phone calls in 30+ languages, RAG pipelines that cite their
sources, and an agent SDK written from scratch and published on npm. He owns the
hard parts: real-time audio pipelines, webhook-driven syncs, background workers,
and reliability work — circuit breakers, retries, dead-letter queues.

At AEOS Labs he builds AI-powered procurement — turning 48-hour RFQ quote
turnarounds into minutes by parsing vendor emails and documents into structured
quote line items.

Guiding quote: "If it can fail, it will. Plan for that first."

## Experience

### Full Stack AI Engineer — AEOS Labs (September 2025 — Present)

- Engineered and shipped a full-stack B2B procurement platform end to end: Next.js frontend (Shadcn/ui, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query) with marketplace, RFQ, and vendor management workflows.
- Reduced RFQ quote turnaround from 48+ hours to minutes via an AI pipeline that parses inbound vendor emails and attachments (PDF, DOCX, Excel) into structured quote line items.
- Architected a TypeScript monorepo with an HTTP API server and an async background job worker, with bidirectional sync to Microsoft Business Central and real-time email ingestion via Microsoft Graph webhooks.
- Production-grade resilience: circuit breakers on external calls, exponential backoff with dead-letter queues, cluster-aware Redis rate limiting, multi-strategy vendor sourcing orchestration.
- Deployed on Azure Container Apps with per-service scaling, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Redis, Blob Storage, and Azure Communication Services.

Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Azure, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, Microsoft Graph API, Docker.

## Projects

### Rika — AI meeting notetaker
Joins Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calls via Recall.ai — capturing
speaker-attributed transcripts and answering questions with cited RAG, both live
in-call through @Rika mentions and after the meeting in a web chat.
Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Recall.ai, Qdrant, Drizzle, Neon, DeepSeek, Clerk.
Live: https://rika.abhijeetkadam.in · GitHub: https://github.com/abhijeet8080/rika

### ARIA — multilingual AI voice agent
Handles inbound phone calls end-to-end — auto-detecting the caller's language
across 30+ languages, booking appointments, and supporting real-time barge-in at
sub-800ms latency via a native audio-to-audio pipeline.
Stack: TypeScript, Hono, Twilio, Gemini Live, Deepgram, Supabase, Upstash Redis.
GitHub: https://github.com/abhijeet8080/Aria-

### redai — TypeScript agent SDK
A from-scratch, provider-agnostic agent SDK published on npm — hand-written
agent loop, tool calling, structured output, guardrails, multi-agent handoffs,
sessions, streaming, and tracing. No agent framework underneath.
Stack: TypeScript, Zod, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, tsup.
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@abhijeetkadam/redai · GitHub: https://github.com/abhijeet8080/redai

### NotebookLM — research assistant with citations
Create notebooks, ingest PDFs, DOCX, websites, YouTube videos, and transcripts,
then ask natural-language questions with streamed answers and inline citations
that open the exact source passage.
Stack: Next.js, Fastify, Clerk, Neon, Qdrant, BullMQ, DeepSeek, Voyage AI.
GitHub: https://github.com/abhijeet8080/notebooklm

### Bugbot — automated PR review bot
Webhook-driven GitHub App: a server enqueues review jobs and a background worker
fetches PR diffs, runs a token-bounded LLM analysis pipeline, and posts inline
review comments directly on the PR.
Stack: TypeScript, Hono, BullMQ, Prisma, PostgreSQL, GitHub App, OpenAI, Docker.
GitHub: https://github.com/abhijeet8080/bugbot
